description: This Java servlet handles deletion of an admin user in the online grocery ordering system. It processes POST requests, retrieves admin ID from the request parameters, calls the database utility to delete the admin, and redirects or forwards the response based on the success of the deletion.

classes.name: DeleteAdmin
classes.description: A servlet class responsible for handling admin deletion requests in the system.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete an admin. Retrieves admin ID from request, calls database utility to delete, and redirects or forwards the user based on outcome.
